 Follow Food Network star, 66, lifts her top to showcase incredible weight loss transformation in new video
 Faye James Thu, November 12, 2026 at 3:59 AM UTC 3 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Valerie Bertinelli is embracing a feel-good moment, and her fans are celebrating alongside her.
 The actress and former Food Network host, 66, shared a playful Instagram video on Tuesday, November 10, modelling her outfit as she prepared for an appearance on The Drew Barrymore Show.
 Wearing a grey cable-knit sweater and high-waisted jeans, Valerie lifted the hem of her top to reveal the waistband before turning sideways to show the fit. "Outfit of the day. Feelin' good," she captioned the clip, tagging the brands behind her look.
 Valerie lifts her top to showcase her weightloss transformation (@ Instagram)
 You may also like
 Valerie Bertinelli shares rare photo with Eddie Van Halen six years after his death 
 Valerie Bertinelli's latest look delights fans
 Valerie paired a $119 BCBG sweater with $188 Mersea jeans, creating an easy combination of cosy knitwear and denim.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Her followers quickly filled the comments with compliments, with many remarking on her appearance and others celebrating her confidence.
 "Girl, you look healthy and happy! SO PRETTY," wrote one admirer.
 Valerie Bertinelli is seen out and about in 2024 (@ GC Images)
 Others described the star as "adorable" and told her she looked fabulous. While the video prompted comments about her slimmer figure, Valerie did not share a weight-loss total or details of a new diet in the post.
 What has Valerie Bertinelli said about weight-loss medication?
 Valerie has previously spoken about her own experiences while urging people to avoid judging the choices others make.
 In an interview with People , she said she had not tried GLP-1 medications but supported those who found them helpful.
 Advertisement Advertisement "I think whatever anybody does to help themselves get to a better place to where they feel good about themselves, they should do it," she said.
 Her broader message was one of compassion, acknowledging how difficult managing weight can be and encouraging people to focus on their own lives rather than scrutinising someone else's decisions.
 Valerie Bertinelli attends 51st Annual Daytime Emmys Awards inn 2024 (@ Getty Images for NATAS)
 Valerie Bertinelli has changed her approach to weight
 The One Day at a Time star has also described moving away from the pressure to achieve rapid results.
 Speaking in April 2024, Valerie explained that patience and paying attention to her emotional wellbeing had become more important than pursuing a quick change on the scales.
 Advertisement Advertisement "I've learned patience," she said. "Stop with the 'lose ten pounds in a week.' Why would you want to?"
 She has continued that conversation on The Drew Barrymore Show, where an earlier appearance saw her reflect on the expectations she faced while working as a diet-company spokesperson.
 Valerie on Kelly Clarkson (@ Weiss Eubanks/NBCUniversal via G)
 Looking back at a photograph from her Hollywood Walk of Fame ceremony, Valerie recalled feeling uncomfortable about her size during what should have been a joyful occasion.
 She explained that her priorities have since shifted towards feeling secure in herself and caring for her mental and emotional health.
 Rather than allowing her clothing size to define her worth, she now places greater importance on her character and relationships.
 Advertisement Advertisement As she told viewers: "What matters is who I am, how I treat people, period."
